chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi narrated to us on Monday, five days remaining of Sha'ban in 353, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Abdillah... from al-Ridha Ali ibn Musa, through his fathers to the Commander of the Faithful Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them all, who said:

The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said to me: O Ali! With you has this matter been opened, and with you shall it be sealed. Be patient, for the good end is for those who guard against evil. You are the party of Allah, and your enemies are the party of Satan. Blessed is he who obeys you, and woe unto those who disobey you. You are the proof of Allah over His creation and the firmest rope; whoever adheres to it finds guidance, and whoever discards it goes astray. I beseech Allah to grant you Paradise; no one precedes you in obedience to Allah, for you are the most worthy of it.

key_terms.حُجَّةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى خَلْقِهِ: Proof of Allah over His creation

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say to Ali about the Imamate and divine authority?
ai.summary: This hadith is transmitted through the full chain of Shia Imams from al-Ridha back to Imam Ali. The Prophet addresses Ali, affirming that the matter of divine authority (Imamate) began and will end with the Ahlulbayt. He describes them as the party of Allah, the divine proof over creation, and the firmest rope of guidance. The original audience was Ali himself, and the terms 'this matter' (al-amr) and 'the firmest rope' (al-urwa al-wuthqa) carried deep theological weight for early Muslims.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 9. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji’abi reported to me on Monday, when five days of Shaban remained, in the year 353, from Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Zayd ibn ‘Ali ibn Al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali Abi Talib (peace be upon him) who said: It was related to me by al-Ridha ‘Ali ibn Musa from his father Musa ibn Ja’far, from his father Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from his father Muhammad ibn ‘Ali, from his father ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali from his father Amirul Mu’mineen ‘Ali ibn Abu Talib, Peace be upon them all, that:

The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny said: "O ‘Ali! With you (all) has Allah begun this matter (i.e. Imamat) and with you (all) shall He end it. So remain patient, for the good end is for those who guard against evil, fearing Allah. You are the army of Allah, and your enemies are the army of Satan. Blessed is he who obeys you and woe unto those who oppose you. You are the divine authority over His creation and the strong rope (of Allah). Whoever adheres to it finds true guidance, and whoever discards it, goes astray. I beseech Allah to grant you Paradise; no one precedes you in your absolute obedience to Allah, and therefore, you are worthier for it."
